result:
task: DAEO-u4oz (W2-04): build addendum 3's three behaviours (S5 an emptied mandatory file, S7 the room ending exactly or at 0, S8a the check when every ticket refuses) with builder tests, in one repair round (DEC-1025).
status: DONE. All three behaviours are built and committed as `de81824be2e8`; the 95 tests in `tests/unit/context` pass.
work_completed: (1) S5: `_read_record` now returns `BLOCKED` when a mandatory file of its own or a dependency ticket holds no text or only whitespace. The message and `details` name the id and the file, the message says "is empty", and `details` carries `empty: true`. The error is raised before any packet or brief is built, so `--brief`, `--dry-run` and the session-start path (`sessionstart.py` calls `context(brief=True)`) all get it. A register entry's span and a missing or unreadable file behave as before. (2) S7: in `stack`, when no item failed to fit but the room is exactly 0 and ranked items remain, `further_batch` is `ranked[taken:taken+size]`, where `size` is the largest `limit` taken, or `BATCH_SIZE` (10) when no batch was taken. The same items go into `dropped` as `budget exceeded`, and `context()` sorts `dropped` into its one order as before. No batch is taken for them, and the room-left-inside-a-batch path is unchanged. (3) S8a: when at least one ticket was computed and every one refused, the check keeps each `REFUSED:` line, prints `unmeasured: no packet was built: every ticket whose context was computed (N) refused over the ceiling, so no packet's hash was compared`, adds the failed/errors line if there were errors, and exits 1. A tree with at least one packet built twice alike keeps its old result.
files_changed: src/gov/context/__init__.py; src/gov/context/context_check.py; src/gov/retrieval/supplementary.py; tests/unit/context/test_bounded.py; tests/unit/context/test_context_check_selection.py
evidence: Commit `de81824be2e8` "W2-04: an emptied mandatory file blocks, the room ending exactly names what is left, an all-refused check is unmeasured", trailers `Task: DAEO-u4oz`, `Role: engineer`, `Implements: CAP-15.d, DEC-860, DEC-1025`, `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`. `git log --oneline -2` shows `de81824b` on top of `a5a53c60`. `git status --short` after the commit shows only the untracked placeholder dotfiles (`.bashrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json`, `.idea`, `.vscode` and others), none committed. Lines changed: code +28 −7 (`__init__.py` +8 −2, `context_check.py` +8 −1, `supplementary.py` +12 −4); tests +150 −12 (`test_bounded.py` +104 −6, `test_context_check_selection.py` +46 −6). The `gov.__file__` line: `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-04/src/gov/__init__.py`. Sandbox check: (a) the write was refused with `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`, exit 1; (b) `git hash-object -w` printed a hash and `git update-index --refresh` exited 0. Identity: `engineer`, `DAEO-u4oz`, `/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-04`, `w2/W2-04`, `a5a53c6096c3`. Cases that show each behaviour: S5: `test_an_emptied_capability_file_blocks_and_is_never_read` (contents "", " ", "\n" and a mix of spaces, tabs and newlines), `test_an_emptied_file_blocks_the_brief_and_the_dry_run_and_writes_no_brief`, `test_an_emptied_dependency_ticket_blocks_and_is_never_read`, `test_an_emptied_file_exits_non_zero_from_the_command` (`gov.cli.main` with `--json`, plain, `--brief` and `--brief --dry-run`: non-zero exit, `ok: false`, code `BLOCKED`), and `test_a_file_with_text_after_whitespace_is_still_read`. S7: room=3 over 30 items of one token gives one batch with limit 3, 3 stacked, and `further_batch` and `dropped` = R-3..R-5; room=12 gives batches (10,10),(2,2) and `further_batch` = R-12..R-21, the largest limit; room=0 over 15 items gives no batch and `further_batch` = R-0..R-9; room=0 over 4 items gives all 4; room=0 with no evidence gives `[]`; evidence that ends exactly with the room gives `[]`; at packet level, `budget` equal to the mandatory tokens gives `further_batch` = both planted notes and `dropped` with both as `budget exceeded`, in sorted order. S8a: `test_every_ticket_refused_is_unmeasured_and_never_green` (one and two tickets), `test_every_computed_ticket_refused_beside_an_error_is_unmeasured_and_red`, and `test_the_same_refusal_twice_beside_a_packet_is_reproduced_named_and_green` (still exit 0).
tests: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-04/src python3 -m pytest tests/unit/context -q -p no:cacheprovider -o tmp_path_retention_policy=failed`: 95 passed. Neighbouring suites that import the context (`tests/unit/{close/test_ratchet,close/test_history,orchestration/test_dispatcher,pause/test_pause,adopt/test_adopt,ci/test_ci_command,launch/test_command_modules,release/test_release}.py` and `tests/unit/retrieval`, run read-only): 391 passed, 1 skipped, 6 failed. All 6 failures are in `test_dispatcher.py` and are `FileNotFoundError` on `.gov-runtime/scratch/orchestrator/tools/land.py` and `close_build.py`, which this worktree does not hold, so they do not touch this change. Acceptance tests not run, as briefed.
discoveries: Three builder tests encoded the readings that addendum 3 replaces, so I rewrote them rather than keeping them: `test_room_that_ends_on_a_batch_s_last_item_leaves_nothing_named`, `test_no_room_takes_no_batch_and_names_nothing_unread` (both expected an empty `further_batch`) and `test_the_same_refusal_twice_is_reproduced_and_named` (expected exit 0 when every ticket refused). Under DEC-866: the comment in `stack` that said `further_batch` holds "nothing that no batch read (DEC-1005, S7a)" carried round 2's reading; DEC-1025 replaces it and I rewrote the comment. Separately, the session-start hook (`template/governance/kernel/hooks/sessionstart.py:157`, outside my paths) swallows every context error with `except Exception: pass`. An emptied file is therefore never shown as present, but the block is not shown either.
risks: `str.strip()` also treats \r, \v, \f and Unicode spaces as whitespace, which is slightly wider than the spec's "spaces, tabs, newlines"; it only blocks more, never fails open. A zero-token chunk (empty text) could still be stacked when the room is 0, because the "does it fit" test is `cost > room`; this was already so and is unchanged.
lessons: `gov.cli.main` takes `--json` and `--root` after the subcommand. The `project` fixture in `test_bounded.py` has a path map that `load_config` rejects (`namespaces` missing), so a CLI-level test has to stub `gov.config.loader.load_config`.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: none
recommended_next_action: The lead merges the test designer's addendum-3 acceptance tests and runs `gov accept` once on `de81824be2e8`.
